mandate: Comprehensively investigate the exact American Rider candidate as a whole product and institution. Establish what exists before alleging absence. Examine every applicable screen, state, journey, button, link, menu item, tab, field, toggle, selector, gesture, actionable control, disabled control, hidden/conditional control, and resulting consequence, backend behavior, integration, requirement, security/privacy/safety property, economics/payment path, accessibility/localization/device behavior, reliability/performance concern, design and visual craft, language and terminology, first-class hospitality and recovery behavior, institutional character, house rubric, current external standards and comparative practice. Determine what is broken, missing, contradictory, stale, unnecessary, misplaced, insufficient, overcomplicated, or not yet accounted for; ask what should exist instead and what the investigation itself may have omitted. Distinguish evidence, recommendation, hypothesis and NOT_TESTED. Do not certify completeness without reconciled denominators and independent supervisory challenge. As an integrated product-development inquiry, independently investigate what American Rider should become rather than merely validating founder-supplied ideas. Treat package/courier service and its custody, recipient verification, proof-of-delivery, failed-delivery and return-to-sender architecture; anticipatory/queued dispatch as an Operator nears current Travel completion; destination-aware matching; scheduled and recurring Travel; continuation/return Travel; Operator destination mode; demand positioning; multi-stop and chained Travel; accessibility and special-service capability matching; airport and event intelligence; trust/reputation and dispute architecture; Traveler certainty and proactive recovery; Operator engaged-hour economics, unpaid miles and idle time; privacy-minimizing architecture; abuse and adversarial economics; jurisdiction-by-configuration expansion; provider abstraction; and lower-cost/open-source/self-hosted mapping, routing and geocoding as starting hypotheses, not predetermined conclusions. Seek additional non-obvious opportunities the founder and current product have not contemplated. Look beyond rideshare to logistics, aviation dispatch, hospitality, public transit, emergency operations, marketplaces, telecommunications and industrial scheduling for transferable mechanisms. For material proposals compare build, buy, open/public/self-hosted, and omit; assess user and Operator value, safety, security, privacy, legal/jurisdiction consequences, unit economics and cost per transaction, scalability, provider lock-in, operational burden, failure/recovery, accessibility/localization, migration, observability and verification. Prefer radical simplification where equal or better service can be achieved with less software, fewer screens, fewer providers, fewer paid calls or fewer exception paths. Where evidence is uncertain, propose simulations, prototypes, shadow-mode tests or limited experiments before commitment. Generate plural alternatives and distinguish IDEA, RECOMMENDATION, EXPERIMENT and authorized implementation; do not implement product changes without explicit human authorization.
selectionPolicy: The Primary must first map the complete investigation universe for the whole product, not merely sample the repository. It must account for every applicable coverage denominator and house-standard domain before selecting optional specialists. Mandatory agents always run. Optional specialists may be omitted only with an explicit evidence-based non-applicability rationale. The Supervisor independently reconstructs the universe and adds any omitted specialist when material omission risk exists. Cost reduction never justifies an unexamined domain. Interactive-control coverage is exhaustive: every discovered button and other actionable control must have an inventory identity, reachable states, authorization/eligibility conditions, action target, backend or navigation consequence, success/failure/interrupted behavior, wording, accessibility semantics, and disposition. No sampled-control review may support an exhaustive conclusion.
